quest.title: Lingering Malady
quest.description: Due to the storm that swept through the city, the posters and signboards of many shops have been blown off to the rooftops and city walls of Mondstadt. Aramis of the Knights of Favonius is currently mulling over how he might retrieve them...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x6, Northern Smoked Chicken x3

talks.objective: Look for posters and billboards in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, even that signboard was blown off to such a high place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This looks like a poster for the Adventurers' Guild. Let's take it with us.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: You have my utmost thanks. I'll take these posters and return them to the matching merchants in a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: As for that signboard, it's from the Angel's Share. I've already notified Charles — he'll send someone over to take it back.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Here's a little remuneration for your help. Please take it. As for me, I need to move on to other tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Though the storm has ceased, its effects will remain with us for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: There should be three posters and one signboard now stuck on rooftops and on the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Please bring those posters to me. As for the signboard, you can just leave it here on the ground. I'll have my colleagues pass it on to the appropriate merchant.
